from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689794/attempts/a536beb1a07649f1b9f85ee1d72dd80c/system/state/workspace/programs/task-89c5afcb.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 6 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        stack.append((ny,nx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            # Recolor the empty interior of each hollow rectangular frame.
            if r1-r0 >= 2 and c1-c0 >= 2:
                fill = 7 if (r1-r0 == 2 and c1-c0 == 2) else 2
                for y in range(r0+1, r1):
                    for x in range(c0+1, c1):
                        if grid[y][x] == 6:
                            out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_transform',p); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
# Build the demo input and expected output, reproducing its four hollow frames.
demo=[[6]*23 for _ in range(24)]
def frame(g,r0,c0,r1,c1,color):
    for c in range(c0,c1+1): g[r0][c]=g[r1][c]=color
    for r in range(r0,r1+1): g[r][c0]=g[r][c1]=color
frame(demo,0,2,7,9,5); frame(demo,2,13,9,20,8); frame(demo,17,6,19,8,5); frame(demo,17,18,20,21,1)
# The source demo has the 3x3 color-3 ring as well.
frame(demo,9,4,11,6,3)
expected=[row[:] for row in demo]
for r0,c0,r1,c1,v in [(0,2,7,9,2),(2,13,9,20,2),(9,4,11,6,7),(17,6,19,8,7),(17,18,20,21,2)]:
    for y in range(r0+1,r1):
        for x in range(c0+1,c1): expected[y][x]=v
actual=mod.transform(demo)
print('demo constructed match:', actual==expected)
test=[[6]*26 for _ in range(10)]; frame(test,5,22,7,24,8)
result=mod.transform(test)
print('test output center:',result[6][23])
print('test shape:',len(result),len(result[0]))
